description: All 16 throughput runs in the predeclared A B B A B A A B engine-only comparison: A is frozen 7d29382 Engine and B is frozen d2d5eb8 Engine; both use the same frozen 7d Gateway and Benchmark. Each stage runs snapshot off then on with one repeat and 500000 measured requests. The complete parent plan, eight host-before records, and all eight stage artifacts are retained. Only actual executable copies and generated data are omitted. Compare adjacent A/B pairs separately by snapshot condition; observed differences do not establish a stable gain or their cause. Original absolute paths and driver Git metadata are provenance, not current file locations or runtime versions.
